title: adhd team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/adhd.yaml: the team layer of the adhd plugin's settings. A value here overrides the same key in the plugin's userConfig. Resolution: plugins/adhd/skills/shape/SKILL.md rule 6.

time_units.description: When true, /adhd:shape may state an estimate of work in minutes, hours, days or weeks; when false it gives a relative size (Small, Medium, Large). A time budget the reader states is kept in the reader's words either way. A quoted "true" or "false" is a string, not a boolean, and is invalid.
